title: Charlottenburg Palace, copper dome and long wings
visualBrief: Principal connected Charlottenburg Palace exterior, including the open southern forecourt/main ranges, western Orangery and end pavilion, eastern New Wing, red ceramic hip roofs/dormers/stacks, pale repeated facades, central three arched recessed portals/thresholds, tall noble windows and supported triangular pediment. Mapped octagonal tower supports a windowed drum/clock, ribbed copper bell dome/oculi, open lantern/cap and an original schematic gilded Fortuna finial. Independent garden/campus buildings, forecourt statue, gardens/fountains and temporary scaffolding remain context. No furnished rooms or copied faces, reliefs, arms or inscriptions.
